caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden box with a flat, overhanging lid that has multiple round holes distributed across its surface. The box sits on a sturdy base and features four turned wooden columns, one at each corner, that support the structure. Both the front and the side panels of the box are decorated with symmetrical patterns of holes that form simple geometric and floral shapes. A twisted metal wire serves as a handle, attached at two points on the lid. The box is colored in varying shades of brown to resemble wood grain, while the handle is rendered in a gray tone to mimic metal. At the bottom of the drawing, there are two smaller, faint pencil sketches showing the box from different angles and with different contents, but these sketches are only outlined and lack color or detail. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Foot Warmer
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
